title.narrative: Sikkim Major District Roads Upgradation Project

description.narrative: The Project Readiness Financing (PRF) will finance consulting services for (i) initial screening of the tentative list of candidate roads and bridges; (ii) feasibility studies of the shortlisted roads for final selection; (iii) detailed design for selected road and bridge subprojects, including the environmental and social safeguard assessments and preparation of environmental and social safeguard planning documents, cost estimate, economic analysis, due diligence and capacity building on financial management, assistance and capacity building on procurement, preparation of bid documents and supporting the bidding process until contract award; and (iv) providing assistance for developing the institutional strengthening and capacity development component of the ensuing proposed Project (Sikkim Major District Roads Upgradation Project).

description.narrative: Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Output 1 Indicator: Feasibility studies and detailed engineering designs for priority subprojects completed. Progress/Status: Feasibility studies completed. EA has prepared the draft detailed design and DPR of selected seven roads (combined length of 76 km) and three standalone bridges (combined length of 220 meters ) for the Phase I project.
The consultant has prepared the draft detailed design of phase II projects of another 75 km length and four stand-alone bridges. The draft detailed design of Phase II projects is under review.
EA submitted PPR ID 11974 of the Phase 1 projects on 11 January 2023 for seeking financial assistance of $121 million from ADB. As a follow-up, the state government had requested the Ministry for Development of North Eastern Region (MDoNER) for counterpart financing from the Central Government Scheme. However, MDoNER expressed its inability to take up the project as a central sector project and has instead asked the State Govt to take it up as a state sector project. Accordingly, EA was advised to approach DEA again to submit the PPR ID 11974 for screening committee consideration in Q1 2024.

Output: Output 1 Indicator: Institutional capacity of PRF executing agency strengthened. Progress/Status: The work in progress. The model bid document of ensuing projects is prepared and under review as of 31 December 2023. EA's proposal for institutional capacity on Road Asset management was approved as a variation in the existing consultant contract in December 2023. The work on institutional capacity improvement is ongoing.
